name: Tamborzão batida
desc: Rio baile funk tamborzão: 808 kicks spelling the tresillo (3+3+2) with slapped tom pairs answering in the back half of the bar and hard claps on the backbeat — the carioca beat of the funk proibidão era. Peak doubles claps and rolls the toms. Frantic, physical, loud.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.5).room(.2), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [mt lt] <~ [lt ~]>").bank("RolandTR808").speed(${tomspd}).gain(${gain}*.55), s("[hh ~]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.22)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ [bd bd] ~]>").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.55), s("~ [cp cp] ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.2), s("~ ~ ~ ~ [mt mt] ~ [mt lt] [lt lt]").bank("RolandTR808").speed(${tomspd}).gain(${gain}*.6), s("[hh ~]*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.24 .14]*4")).lastOf(2, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
